bounded_extract.candidate_institution: CERT=14 as a documented API example, not a representative bank
bounded_extract.request_bounds: At most 10000 rows per request, 32 MiB total, no credentials; stop and report pagination/truncation rather than silently sample.
bounded_extract.units: Do not assign dollars/thousands or sum SOD records until the selected dictionary confirms units and row granularity.
bounded_extract.unit_continuity: CERT identifies a reported institution, not a guaranteed constant economic perimeter. Inspect mergers/conversions/branch transfers; retain entry/exit; do not interpolate across breaks or assume branch identifiers persist.
bounded_extract.vintage: Observation years before cutoff do not prove a pre-cutoff release. The local API spec was acquired 2026-10-12. Freeze custodial archive/version and selected dictionary before any historical-vintage claim.

existing_macro.anchor: Preserved public macro local-projection study; not rerun here

independent_local_route.generated_law: N=60 institutions, T=20 quarters; alpha_i~N(0,1), x_it=0.5*x_i,t-1+u_it, y_it=alpha_i+lambda_t+0.4*x_i,t-1+eps_it, iid u/eps with unit variance; lambda_t=0.2*sin(t/3). Set x_i0=0.
independent_local_route.clock: x at t-1 precedes y at t; common calendar retained. Baseline slope is known only in the declared generated law.
independent_local_route.stress: Corrupt five institution histories at a known midpoint; compare correct continuity map, naive merge and break-aware refusal. Add common shocks to test false iid covariance.
independent_local_route.comparators: Within-institution/time regression with institution-cluster covariance versus pooled OLS and naive iid covariance; no claim that cluster asymptotics are exact with 60 units.
independent_local_route.evaluation: 300 independent generated panels, development seed 15201 and reserved final seed 15291; report bias, availability, coverage MC interval, width and break-detection errors; register exact code first.

review_disposition: Proposal design complete with generated primary route and a conditional FDIC extract contract. Field dictionaries inspected; historical bytes, scaling and unit histories remain explicit prerequisites of the optional FDIC empirical claim. No public extract or panel result is claimed.
